structural_change: Per-region span and extent are registered in the existing classification edges, and bump placement uses page carry plus the low offset byte instead of subtraction followed by addition. This removes the 21-level rk-to-table-write allocator path (~847 ps) without adding service cycles. Physical master is ot_hgi_sv_head as granted in the current die contract; dense-face placement uses measured hold-strip spread. Measured CTS worst path a_lo[0] to w[307] is -111.1 ps: split base-origin subtraction and local-base addition over the existing allocation A/B edges, no extra service edges. CTS relocation attempt still measured a_delta[22] at -90.5 ps. Precompute each own-region base-origin in CL0; forward-origin capture in SK0 then forward base-origin subtraction in SK1. Allocation A now selects registered offsets and B adds local base. Every existing decode/service edge is preserved.
